title: Using AI to Create Synthetic Data
summary: A project for SIX Banking Services evaluating GAN-based synthetic tabular data generation for privacy-preserving analytics, examining trade-offs between resemblance, utility, and privacy. It vendors and modifies CTGAN's synthesizer to add differential-privacy training (via opacus) and uses SDV's TVAE synthesizer, Metadata schema, and evaluate() function to benchmark synthetic data quality.
evidence: ctgan_synthesizer.py:63 defines a modified CTGANSynthesizer using opacus DP components; evaluation.py:1 imports sdv.evaluation.evaluate and sdv.metrics.tabular
needs: Unclear whether the modified ctgan_synthesizer.py fully replaces the original package or is used alongside sdv.tabular.CTGAN; treated as derivative_work of ctgan.
